attribution.note: Marcus's own sentence in his Substack post, written in his own voice. He is not quoting anyone else.

semantics.note: This is a present-tense observation about NHTSA data. Saying 'automated driving systems' is a little broader than the post, which is mainly about Tesla Level 2 and Waymo. That still fairly captures what he committed to.

contract.note: The plain reading is fair and ordinary: NHTSA recorded continuing collisions with stopped vehicles during automated or assisted driving in the 2021–22 window. Allowing contemporaneous NHTSA investigation records stretches slightly past 'the NHTSA report data', but it does not distort the observation.

evidence.note: An NHTSA EA22-002 record, available 2022-06-09. It lists Autopilot crashes into stopped first-responder or attenuator trucks in Orlando (Aug 2021), Petaluma (Sep 2021) and Desert Center (Jan 2022), all inside the window. It also notes the investigation drew on SGO data.

reviews.rationale: NHTSA's own investigation record documents several crashes in the July 2021–May 2022 window where Tesla Autopilot vehicles failed to avoid stopped emergency vehicles. That meets the support condition. The specific June 15 SGO tables were not checked (403), but the contract allows corroboration from investigation records. No counterevidence was found.
